Nina interview · section 1 of 9 · point 1.1 · round 3 · accepted

The front page must look like a game, not a slideshow

What Nina hit: after the intro she expected to play. Instead she scrolled. "It looks like a presentation." It never occurred to her that she had to click.
Round 1 result: button label wrong, "no maths" unclear, sticker useless. All three applied.

What changed (3 things)

  1. The button says "Play the game" (Czech: "Zahraj si hru"). Big, red, full width on a phone, play icon.
  2. The line under it is now "12 terms · one game each". The number is read from terms.json, so it changes when a term is added or removed. "No maths" is gone.
  3. The "Start here" sticker is gone. The bottom button matches the top one.
